findings.evidence: `SmoothEmbedding/SmoothAmbientIsotopy/Basic.lean:14-24,70-85` explicitly identifies `SmoothEmbedding.SmoothAmbientIsotopic`—witnessed by a diffeotopy—as the equivalence needed by geometric knot presentations and distinguishes it from `ContinuousAmbientIsotopic`; the new definition instead expands at lines 55-62 to `∃ Φ : AmbientIsotopy M, ...`.
findings.fix: Define the link relation using a single `Diffeotopy I ∞ M` carrying every component pointwise, add the necessary manifold assumptions, and derive the continuous relation only as a consequence.
findings.issue: `ContinuousAmbientIsotopic` forgets smoothness and permits an arbitrary topological `AmbientIsotopy`, making the canonical setoid weaker than smooth ambient isotopy.

summary: The setoid uses continuous ambient isotopy, so it does not provide the smooth ambient-isotopy equivalence required for smooth link presentations.
